detail.longDescription: Gemini is everywhere in Google apps: it can read your emails, pull in data from your calendar, and find that file you accidentally saved to your work Drive. But no matter how much of your work is in Google, there are always other apps you'll need Gemini to access: things like your CRM, project management tool, marketing automation platform, and help desk, to name a few. Gemini connectors add a few of those apps into the mix, and with Zapier, you can securely extend that reach to apps across you
